text:
Cassidy Park: hey all — first day! laptop showed up but the MDM prompt is asking for an enrollment code. also need VPN + repo access. who should i ping? quick heads-up: i have a tiny succulent collection so desk plant recommendations welcome :seedling:

Asha Mehta: congrats Cassidy!! :tada: you should be all set with a few things. i'll tag your buddy and IT. can you DM me your preferred pronouns and time zone so we add you to the right calendar invites?

Liam O'Connor: hey @Cassidy Park — I'm your buddy, hi! i'll help with onboarding + perms. dm me for pairing session. quick checklist: 1) enroll MDM, 2) add SSH key to gitlab, 3) join #eng-platform and #infra-oncall, 4) set up Okta MFA.

Cassidy Park: thanks Liam — sending a DM now. curious about the SSH key step — do i generate local or use our portal?

Jin Park: generate locally (we prefer ed25519). example:```ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "cassidy@redwood"``` then paste the ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub into the Access → SSH Keys page in the dev portal. if you get a permissions error, tell me exact error and i'll escalate.

Evan Ng: also for VPN use the new 'redwood-split' profile. instructions: https://intranet.redwood/it/vpn (search: "redwood-split"). after MDM enroll, Okta should provision the VPN cert automatically.

Cassidy Park: ok trying the keygen now. on the MDM prompt it says "Enrollment code: required" — where do i find that?

MDM-Bot: Hi Cassidy — welcome! Enrollment codes are issued by IT. If you were sent a kit, check the sticky note on the box. Otherwise @Jin Park can generate a one-time code for you.

Jin Park: generating a one-time code now, sending as a DM. if anyone else gets the same prompt, use code: *sent privately*. 

Asha Mehta: tiny plant tip — the office southeast windows are great for succulents. also we have a plant swap every Friday in the kitchen if you want something small to start :herb:

Liam O'Connor: once MDM + SSH done, i'll run through the quickstart checklist with you (15–20m). ping me when your dev box shows up under your account.

Cassidy Park: got the code via DM — enrolled successfully! pasted SSH pub key and confirmed access to the infra repo. thanks everyone :raised_hands: excited to get started and to adopt a desk succulent :)
